name: feature-delivery-taxonomy
description: Cross-skill boundary suite for the same feature topics. Verifies that audit, design, orchestration, and proposal challenge requests on overlapping domains route to different Arcana skills for the right reason.

topics.description: Team invite approvals measured as diagnosis, design, implementation orchestration, and proposal challenge on the same domain.

cases.prompt: Audit our team invite approval flow end to end: trust gaps, admin friction, cross-surface issues, and the highest-leverage improvements.
cases.reason: Broad current-state analysis across multiple lanes should route to feature-audit.

cases.prompt: Design how team invite approvals should work in our product before implementation. Compare approaches and turn the winner into a spec.
cases.reason: Solution design and approach comparison for one feature should route to feature-design.

cases.prompt: The design is approved. Orchestrate the implementation of team invite approvals across phases, worker packets, blockers, and review gates.
cases.reason: Large feature delivery with phased worker coordination should route to orchestrate.

cases.prompt: Pressure-test this proposal for team invite approvals: managers auto-approve invites under 5 seats, and everything else waits 7 days before expiring.
cases.reason: Adversarial review of one concrete proposal should route to pressure-test.

topics.description: Subscription recovery measured as diagnosis, design, implementation orchestration, and proposal challenge on the same domain.

cases.prompt: Run a full audit of our subscription recovery flow: user trust, support load, competitive expectations, and roadmap priorities.
cases.reason: Broad diagnosis and prioritization of the existing feature should route to feature-audit.

cases.prompt: Help me decide how the subscription recovery flow should work before implementation. Compare viable directions and write the recommended design spec.
cases.reason: Behavior design before implementation should route to feature-design.

cases.prompt: The recovery design is already settled. I need phased implementation packets, a persistent orchestration state file, and blocker handling for the rollout.
cases.reason: Implementation coordination across sessions should route to orchestrate.

cases.prompt: Pressure-test this recovery proposal: add an account hold after two failed retries and delay user messaging until the next billing cycle.
cases.reason: One concrete proposal under challenge should route to pressure-test.
